changes: Independent CUDA miner and C# Windows host based on pinned Apache-2.0 consensus parameters. Adds prefix-state caching, linear transforms, native NOID Stratum, failover, TLS verification, per-session nonce allocation and NVML thermal protection. Version 0.2.2 replaces bit-serial field multiplication with interleaved-bit integer products and Karatsuba composition, increases adaptive nonce batches, and adds independent GPU arithmetic differential checks. No proprietary miner code or binaries incorporated.
macBranchNote: Historical Windows provenance, not Mac capabilities. Vector bytes now use Git canonical LF for portable integrity checks; JSON values are unchanged.
